newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells 25,000/t Oct naphtha to Korean refiner.
newsitem.headline: India sells 25,000/t Oct naphtha to Korean refiner.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold through a tender 25,000 tonnes of naphtha to a Korean refiner at $25.55 per tonne below North West European (NWE) spot quotes on a free-on-board basis, traders said on Monday.
IOC had offered 25,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha (HAN) lifting from Bombay on the west coast between October 17-19. The tender closed on October 2 and offers were valid until October 4.
Its last ex-Bombay HAN cargo, lifting September 27-29, was sold at $25.84 below NWE quotes.
